nodes.label: StateGraph.add_node / add_conditional_edges
nodes.desc: Declarative builder: register node functions, fixed edges, and router functions; state fields map to channels

nodes.label: StateGraph.compile()
nodes.desc: Validates the graph, materializes channels, and returns a CompiledStateGraph wired for execution

nodes.label: Pregel engine
nodes.desc: The runnable engine every compiled graph becomes; executes nodes in Pregel-style supersteps

nodes.label: PregelLoop (superstep tick)
nodes.desc: One loop iteration: plan tasks from pending channel updates, tick the runner, apply writes, snapshot a checkpoint

nodes.label: PregelRunner.tick
nodes.desc: Executes the node functions of a superstep concurrently and collects their channel writes

nodes.label: apply_writes / prepare_single_task
nodes.desc: Core algorithm: resolves task inputs from channels and applies node writes with version tracking

nodes.label: Channels: LastValue / Topic / EphemeralValue
nodes.desc: Typed state slots with reducers: last-write-wins, append-only, or cleared-each-step

nodes.label: add_messages reducer
nodes.desc: The default reducer for message lists: merges, dedupes, and upserts messages by ID

nodes.label: BaseCheckpointSaver.put / get_tuple
nodes.desc: Persistence contract: save a versioned checkpoint per superstep, load a thread's state for resume

nodes.label: InMemorySaver
nodes.desc: In-memory saver for prototyping; swap for Postgres/SQLite savers without touching graph code

nodes.label: interrupt() / Command(resume=...)
nodes.desc: Human-in-the-loop: raise a resumable GraphInterrupt from a node, resume with a Command carrying the answer

nodes.label: create_react_agent + ToolNode
nodes.desc: The 'agent' preset: just a StateGraph cycling model-call and tool nodes, compiled like any other graph
